metadata.title: Rustic Country Album Cover with Fire

retrievalProfile.description: A desaturated, high-contrast rural landscape featuring a lone figure in a cowboy hat and a small, vibrant campfire as the primary color focal point.
excludeWhen: urban or modern settings are requested
clean, minimalist vector art is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A desaturated, grainy photograph of a man in a cowboy hat walking past a small, bright orange campfire in a dry field, topped with a mix of classic serif and casual script typography.
coreVisualRelationships: The vibrant orange fire acts as the sole high-saturation element against a muted background.
The figure's motion blur contrasts with the sharp, static landscape.
The typography is anchored in the upper-left quadrant, balancing the figure on the right.
The horizon line divides the composition into a textured foreground and a soft, overcast sky.
coreInvariants: The campfire must remain the only source of high-chroma color.
The figure must wear a wide-brimmed cowboy hat.
The overall image must have a desaturated, film-grain texture.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A man in a cowboy hat is positioned on the right third of the frame, shown from the waist up in a dynamic, walking pose.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A small, intense campfire in the lower-left foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright fire, moves diagonally up to the text, and then follows the figure's motion toward the right edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The expansive, pale sky and the open field provide significant breathing room for the typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated greys and muted greens in the landscape.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Off-white sky providing a backdrop for dark text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vivid orange and yellow in the campfire and a single word of script text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation across 90% of the frame, with a sudden spike in saturation at the fire and specific text elements.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Classic Roman serif and casual cursive script.
letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses a high-contrast serif with sharp terminals.
Secondary text uses a fluid, connected script with varying line weights.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The script text features an elongated 'P' and 'n' to create a sense of movement.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between formal, authoritative serif and personal, informal script.
graphicDevices: Color-coding specific words to match the visual anchor (fire).

preserve: Wide tracking in the serif font
The specific burnt orange accent color

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the classic, high-contrast serif look.
Captures the casual, handwritten script feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a desaturated, grainy photograph of a rural field at dusk with a line of trees in the distance. On the right, a man in a cowboy hat and denim jacket is walking, captured with slight motion blur. In the lower-left foreground, a small, bright orange campfire is burning intensely.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary artist name in a wide-tracked, dark grey serif font in the upper left. Below it, add the title in a casual script font, with the final word in a burnt orange color that matches the fire.

verificationChecks: Is the fire the most saturated element?
Is the serif text uppercase and wide-tracked?
Does the figure have motion blur?

mustRedesign: Avoid using specific artist names or logos
Ensure the script font is legible against the sky
postGenerationChecks: Check that the orange text color matches the fire's core.
Verify the serif font has high contrast between thick and thin strokes.
Ensure the horizon line is straight but natural.
Confirm the motion blur on the figure feels intentional and not like a low-quality image.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a desaturated, grainy outdoor action shot with a high-saturation focal point and a mix of formal serif and informal script typography.
